transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I’m Dr. [Your Name]. Can you tell me what’s been going on that brought you in today?

Well, hello Doctor. I came in today because of my eating. I have these nights where I just eat... a whole lot. And afterward, I'll just sit there with crumbs and empty food containers all around me, and I feel so ashamed and just... disgusted with myself. 

It bothers me so much that the next morning, I can hardly even bring myself to pray. I can't even look folks at church in the eye anymore. I just knew I needed to finally talk to someone about it.
After these episodes of eating a lot, do you ever try to compensate by making yourself vomit, using laxatives, fasting, or exercising a lot more than usual?

No, I don't do anything like that. I've never tried to make myself throw up, and I don't take laxatives or anything. And... well, I certainly don't go out and exercise afterwards. 

I just eat all that food, and then I just sit there with it. I don't try to get rid of it or undo it, I just feel terrible about it.
Can you describe how long these episodes of eating a lot usually last? Do they happen all night, or is there a specific timeframe in which you feel like you're really overeating?

It doesn't go on all night, no. It usually just happens all in one sitting. 

Like, on a bad night, I can start with a plate of leftover funeral-luncheon casserole... and before I know it, I've eaten that, half a pan of brownies, some biscuits, and whatever chicken salad is in the fridge. I just eat it all right then and there in that one timeframe.
During these times when you're eating a lot, do you feel like you can't stop yourself or that you're not in control of how much you're eating?

Yes, that's exactly how it feels. Once I take that first bite—usually after everyone's gone to bed and the house is quiet—it's like my good sense just steps aside. 

I'll literally be sitting there telling myself, "Belinda, stop now, you don't need this," but my hands just keep reaching for more. I just... I can't seem to make myself stop once I start.
